question: A reduction of 15% in the price of wheat enables a housewife to buy 6 kg more for ₹2,720. The reduced price of wheat per kg (in ₹) is:
solution:
Given:

A reduction of 15% in the price of wheat enables a housewife to buy 6 kg more for ₹2,720.

Calculation:

Let the C.P of wheat per kg be x

Total quantity of wheat in ₹ 2720 = 2720/x

New price = x – x × (15/100)

⇒ (100 - 15)x/100

⇒ 85x/100 or 17x/20

New quantity of wheat in ₹ 2720 = 2720/(17x/20)

⇒ 2720 × (20/17x)

⇒ 3200/x

Now,

(3200/x) – 2720/x = 6

⇒ (480)/x = 6 

⇒ x = 80

New price of wheat per kg = 80 × (17/20)

⇒ 68

**∴ The reduced price of wheat per kg (in ₹) is 68.**
